meta.name: Zama Soft Product Utility DNA
meta.description: A CachePot adaptation of Zama's soft utility language. It uses a floating top menu, a full marketing landing page, high-radius surfaces, focused task layouts and image-led onboarding.

color.palette_type: monochromatic neutral system with one warm high-chroma accent

primary.role: active navigation, token identity and confidential-state emphasis

secondary.role: primary text and dimensional financial action controls

accent.role: quiet workspace surfaces, selected rows and grouped utility areas

neutral.usage: white and off-white dominate; gray separates data layers; near-black carries nearly all typography

color.contrast_strategy: near-black on pale neutral surfaces; yellow is sparse and never used for long text

typography.font_style_notes: neutral neo-grotesk product typography; regular weight does most of the work; hierarchy comes from scale and space rather than font-family contrast

spacing.content_density: low-density application shell with focused transactional interiors
spacing.section_rhythm: 24–32px inside workspaces, 48–64px between major product sections, 96px only for marketing moments

layout.grid_system: floating top navigation shell plus a centered fluid product workspace
layout.columns: 12-column marketing canvas; primary application tasks use 768–896px centered columns
layout.alignment_tendency: centered statements and narrow task surfaces; data lists remain strictly aligned inside soft containers

shape.border_usage: translucent 1px edge highlights clarify soft glass-like surfaces
shape.divider_style: low-contrast neutral dividers contained within rounded surfaces

elevation.shadow_style: soft directional depth with a consistent upper-left light source
elevation.depth_cues: large radius, inner highlight, subtle tonal gradient and layered soft shadow

iconography.style: simple outlined utility symbols with occasional solid brand marks
iconography.preferred_set: Lucide-compatible outline icons plus custom Zama/token marks

motion.entrance_pattern: short opacity transition with 4–8px vertical movement for overlays only
motion.exit_pattern: fast fade with no decorative travel
motion.philosophy: minimal functional motion that confirms state without competing with financial data

components.button_style: 40–48px controls with 12–16px radius; dimensional ink primary, soft white secondary and yellow used as signal rather than default fill
components.input_style: 96px soft elevated field with 40–48px numeric value and inset token selector
components.card_style: 18–28px rounded neutral surface with inner edge highlight, low-chroma gradient and soft directional shadow
components.navigation_pattern: inset sticky top menu with a pale-yellow active item; mobile uses a top toggle and inline floating drawer
components.modal_style: centered or side-sheet white surface with explicit title, concise explanation and hard action hierarchy
components.list_style: comfortable data rows with token identity first, aligned metadata and lifted row actions
components.component_notes: privacy state is expressed with labels, icons and reveal controls rather than ornamental encryption textures

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a secure financial workstation where confidential assets behave like familiar banking primitives
aesthetic.era_influence: contemporary Swiss product design with light industrial and terminal influences

visual_language.complexity: moderate information complexity with minimal visual complexity
visual_language.ornamentation: restrained 3D product imagery, glass refraction and yellow edge light are concentrated in onboarding surfaces
visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous around page-level hierarchy and primary tasks, comfortable inside controls and lists
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: the floating top menu, centered statement and image-led product surface form three distinct depth planes
visual_language.focal_strategy: one dominant task per screen, supported by quiet secondary data
visual_language.contrast_level: high text contrast and low surface contrast
visual_language.texture_usage: soft studio materiality through translucent glass, subtle surface gradients and directional shadows

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast, spatial isolation, surface elevation and sparse accent color
composition.flow_direction: top navigation to landing statement or page title, then primary operation and supporting data
composition.grouping_strategy: large-radius floating panels; related controls stay within one focused transaction surface
composition.negative_space_role: separates tasks and lowers perceived cryptographic complexity

imagery.photo_treatment: bright high-key studio renders with cool neutral grading and controlled yellow refraction
imagery.illustration_style: premium translucent 3D product objects supported by sparse utility iconography
imagery.graphic_elements: token marks, privacy symbols, glass vessels, metallic components and soft shadows
imagery.pattern_usage: none in operational UI; occasional brand repetition is acceptable in marketing surfaces
imagery.image_shape: large 20–28px rounded crops integrated into soft product cards

interaction_feel.feedback_style: immediate state label, disabled state, progress message and transaction confirmation
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: subtle gray surface change or black/yellow inversion
interaction_feel.loading_style: plain initialization copy, slim progress indicators and low-motion skeletons

brand_voice_in_ui.cta_style: direct imperative verbs such as Shield, Unshield, Send, Deposit and Connect
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: explain why data is unavailable, then offer one concrete next action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: specific, calm and recoverable; explain network or confidentiality implications when relevant

overview.fallback_strategy: remove transitions and keep all state changes explicit in text and color

background_effects.description: cool pale-neutral workspace with a restrained upper-right ambient light field

particle_systems.description: no particles in the product interface

3d_elements.description: onboarding and dashboard cards use high-key glass and metal 3D campaign imagery

params.materials: clear crystal, frosted glass, satin metal and translucent yellow polymer
params.geometry: single branded privacy or token object per card

image_effects.description: 3D campaign renders are cropped into high-radius cards with a light tonal overlay

params.shadow_type: layered soft directional shadow with inset highlight

canvas_drawings.description: no canvas layer in the operational UI

svg_animations.description: SVG is used for logos and utility icons without visible path animation

visual_effects.composite_notes: The live Zama dashboard, Shield route and mobile Shield layout were inspected directly on 2026-08-14. The dominant identity is a floating large-radius shell, soft directional depth, focused transaction cards and high-key translucent 3D imagery. Yellow is a navigation and privacy signal; dimensional black controls carry primary financial actions.
